WorkshopPost.title: WorkshopPost
WorkshopPost.description: Public workshop blog publication created by an authenticated attendee. Contains zero raw email PII.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the post author (immutable after creation).

authorName.description: Public display name chosen by the workshop attendee.

title.description: Title of the published workshop project.

description.description: Optional process notes, concept, or reflection.

promptUsed.description: Optional AI prompt shared by the attendee.

contentType.description: Primary media format of the publication.

mediaDataUrl.description: Optional client-compressed JPEG/PNG/WebP data URL preview (<= 380 KB so Firestore document remains well under 1 MB).

uploadedFileUrl.description: Optional server-hosted binary upload path for direct PDF or MP4/WebM/MOV files uploaded by a verified attendee.

externalUrl.description: Optional external HTTP/HTTPS link (Web project, YouTube/Vimeo video, Google Drive PDF/video, Canva, etc.).

fileName.description: Original filename for uploaded preview images.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the compressed preview image.

fileSizeBytes.description: Byte size of the stored image preview.

status.description: Publication lifecycle status. 'archived' is a terminal state for non-admin authors.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via request.time on creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via request.time on creation and updates.

WorkshopContact.title: WorkshopContact
WorkshopContact.description: Private attendee contact record isolated from public workshop_posts to enforce PII protection. Readable only by the owner or verified workshop admin.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the attendee.

postTitle.description: Title of the linked workshop publication.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via request.time on creation.

AdminMember.title: AdminMember
AdminMember.description: Trusted administrator registry document managed only by the bootstrapped workshop admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/workshop_posts/{postId}.description: Publicly browsable workshop blog entries without email PII.

/workshop_contacts/{postId}.description: Private attendee email and contact records paired atomically with workshop_posts.
